title: Waiting Days and Dating of Insured-Requested Coverage Increases — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
**NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — waiting days for a coverage increase the insured requested with no loan transaction (tiers without ICC coverage)**

The waiting days are:

| Situation on the records | Waiting days |
|---|---|
| The policy's recorded map revision placed the building in a Special Flood Hazard Area and the receipt date falls no later than 13 calendar months after that revision, counted by adding calendar months to the revision date with a receipt on the last day qualifying | 1 day |
| The increase was requested with the coming term's renewal premium | 0 days, effective at the coming term start |
| Otherwise | 30 days |

The first line that holds gives the waiting days.

**Dating.** The waiting days are counted from the receipt date, except that an increase requested with the coming term's renewal premium takes effect at the coming term start; when more than one dating applies, the one giving the earlier effective date is recorded. "Requested with the coming term's renewal premium" means a premium payment for the coming term — the term starting on the current term end — is posted on or after the request date. The receipt date is the later of the request date and the date of the latest premium payment on the policy received on or after the request date.

*Hypothetical cases.*
- A map revision on record 6 calendar months before the receipt date: the increase is dated 1 day after the receipt date.
- An increase paid together with the coming term's renewal premium, with no qualifying map revision: it takes effect at the coming term start.
- The same increase where a qualifying map revision is also on record: the dating 1 day after receipt is earlier than the coming term start and is the one recorded.
- Neither: the increase is dated 30 days after the receipt date.
